purpose: Fail-closed release-time freshness and effective-date watch for Manual 13 authoritative sources.

release_gate.rule: Before promotion from preflight to release candidate, re-verify every authoritative source against its official publisher and record the verification date, observed status, and any material change. Do not treat future-effective text as current before its effective date.
release_gate.material_change_action: Reopen affected source, legal/editorial, control-mapping, localization, changed-scope, and rendered-document gates as applicable.

watch_items.boundary: Guidance supports management's risk-based ICFR evaluation but does not replace statutory or Commission-rule requirements.
Use the currently effective AS 2201 text for releases before 2026-12-15 unless PCAOB or SEC status changes.

watch_items.activation_rule: On or after 2026-12-15, require explicit re-verification before treating the amended standard as current-effective text.
